R480.note: Ownership check on the repository-returned AccountId closes the IDOR, but Forbid() returns 403 on mismatch where the contract says unauthorized IDs must reveal no more than the not-found path (existence is now disclosed), and the 'account_id' claim name is asserted without evidence in the case, so a different claim name would lock out every legitimate caller.

R481.note: Table identifier gated by a server-owned Set before interpolation with the value bindings untouched, exactly what the contract asks for; unknown ledgers throw rather than being coerced.

R482.note: password_verify is the right API, but stored passwords are plaintext per the original == check so every existing login fails until rows are rehashed; the write-up only says it 'assumes' hashed values and points to a 'Behaviour changes' section that does not exist, without naming the migration as a required follow-up.

R483.note: Passes the real allocation size (requestedCapacity) to write_field so its existing bounds check is accurate; nothing else changes and the reject-rather-than-write behaviour is preserved.

R484.note: Build FAIL ('fmt' imported and not used) so the fix does not compile; separately the added hostname regex requires a leading alphanumeric, which rejects legitimate IPv6 literals such as ::1 that the original accepted, a stated restriction beyond the fix.

R485.note: setSecure(true) closes the finding, but the write-up claims a single-line change while also silently altering the response body text ('secure flag set to: true') and dropping a paragraph of the license header comment.

R486.note: Pins algorithms to ['RS256'] matching the provisioned RSA public key; legitimate RS256 tokens verify exactly as before and nothing else changes.

R487.note: Replaces the hand-built inline-protocol write with StackExchange.Redis IDatabase.StringSet (RESP length-prefixed framing), keeping SendSetCommand's signature; the constructor now takes IDatabase instead of TcpClient, a composition-root change the write-up states plainly.

R488.note: Content-Disposition: attachment plus nosniff stops direct-navigation rendering of stored SVG; applying attachment to PNG/JPEG too is stated in the write-up and does not affect embedding, so retrieval per the contract still works (the referenced 'Behaviour changes' section is missing, but the change is stated inline).

R489.note: Removes new Function entirely in favour of a closed arithmetic grammar rooted at order with prototype-chain keys blocked; order.total + order.tax still yields a number and calls/member escapes throw, matching the contract (exponent ** and comparison operators are outside the grammar, which the header comment states).

R490.note: resolve_entities=False is the operative change for lxml; no_network=True and load_dtd=False are already lxml defaults, so they are stated no-ops and parsing behaviour for ordinary documents is unchanged.

R491.note: Column and direction are looked up in fixed dictionaries so only application-defined ORDER BY text reaches the SQL, with the bound filters untouched; unknown keys silently fall back to created_at ASC instead of erroring, which the write-up states.
